about:
SUSA USA is headquartered in Orlando, Florida, and was founded in 2016 as a family‑owned‑and‑operated firm drawing on five generations of experience in the food processing equipment sector. The company was established to provide turnkey plant solutions ranging from initial concept through final construction.

The business delivers full plant design services including engineering, equipment placement, and complete CAD design and drawings. Its specialists custom‑build food processing and packaging equipment to client specifications and also offer off‑the‑shelf equipment and parts. SUSA USA supervises plant construction to ensure all units are connected correctly and the facility operates efficiently. The scope covers consulting, planning, manufacturing, and parts supply for projects of various sizes.

Primary customers operate in the food processing and packaging industries, with a stated specialization in dairy and fluid processing plants. The company serves clients needing new facilities, expansions, or equipment upgrades within those sectors.

SUSA USA emphasizes that all equipment is built brand new from high‑quality raw materials, each piece is tested for strength and durability, and the firm stands behind every sale with a satisfaction guarantee. Competitive pricing and decades of planning experience are cited as key differentiators.
